projects.title: Commit
projects.subtitle: AI Git commit generator powered by local LLM via Ollama

overview.problem: Crafting clean, descriptive, and standardized Conventional Commit messages for complex or multi-file staged diffs is tedious, and sending proprietary source code to external cloud AI APIs poses serious privacy risks.
overview.solution: A lightweight, zero-dependency local CLI tool that inspects staged Git changes and prompts a locally running LLM through Ollama (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b) to generate structured Conventional Commits, featuring Map-Reduce synthesis for massive diffs and full interactive controls.

gallery.title: Interactive CLI & Conventional Commit Generation
gallery.description: Pre-flight Ollama health check, staged file listing, live streaming spinner, and interactive [Y/E/R/N] commit menu.

gallery.title: Map-Reduce Engine for Large Diffs
gallery.description: Intelligent multi-stage pipeline: auto-filtering lockfiles, preserving file boundaries across chunks, parallel per-chunk summarization, and final synthesis.

features.name: Local LLM Execution via Ollama
features.description: Runs entirely on your machine with models like qwen2.5-coder:7b. No external APIs, no internet required, ensuring complete code confidentiality.

features.name: Interactive Commit Flow
features.description: Prompt menu allows one-key actions: Accept & commit (Y), open in external editor like Notepad/$EDITOR/nano (E), regenerate (R), or cancel (N).

features.name: Map-Reduce for Large Diffs
features.description: Automatically filters lockfiles and generated assets, splits huge staged diffs without breaking files apart, generates per-chunk summaries, and synthesizes one coherent message.

features.name: Commit History Logger & Zero-Dependency Setup
features.description: Appends every successful commit with timestamp and repo path to commit_history.json. Built with pure Python standard library for zero pip installation overhead.

technicalDecisions.reasoning: Eliminates privacy concerns by keeping sensitive diffs and proprietary source code strictly on the local developer machine.
Diffs exceeding 20,000 characters trigger automatic filtering of lockfiles, file-boundary preservation, and two-tier summarization to prevent LLM context overflows and hallucinations.
Removes all third-party package dependencies and virtual environment requirements, enabling instant global PATH execution across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

projects.title: InsightEX
projects.subtitle: Real-time AI retail analytics engine with pose tracking, heatmaps, and privacy anonymization

overview.problem: Retailers lack real-time visibility into customer foot traffic, dwell bottlenecks, and staff assistance needs, while standard CCTV surveillance poses serious customer privacy risks and fails under real-world occlusions.
overview.solution: An end-to-end computer vision retail intelligence engine combining YOLOv8 pose estimation, DeepSORT tracking, 2D Gaussian foot-traffic heatmaps with temporal decay, GDPR face anonymization, and a multi-client live web dashboard.

gallery.title: Real-Time Tracking & Heatmap Dashboard
gallery.description: Multi-person pose tracking, 2D Gaussian foot-traffic heatmap accumulation, dwell-time analytics, and exclusion zone boundary monitoring.

gallery.title: Store Floor Traffic & Density Mapping
gallery.description: Perspective-accurate 2D Gaussian density splatting tracking foot-traffic hotspots and customer paths across the retail floor.

gallery.title: Dwell-Time Monitoring & Bottleneck Detection
gallery.description: Automated dwell-time threshold tracking identifying shopper interest zones and high-congestion retail sections.

gallery.title: Exclusion Zone Perimeter Monitoring
gallery.description: Custom polygon boundary surveillance triggering instant alerts for restricted staff-only or high-security areas.

features.name: Real-Time Person Tracking & Dwell Alerts
features.description: DeepSORT tracking with an occlusion grace period (TRACK_LOST_GRACE_SECONDS = 3.0s) prevents dwell timer resets during temporary camera occlusions, triggering automated alerts when customer dwell thresholds are exceeded.

features.name: Perspective-Accurate 2D Gaussian Heatmaps
features.description: Ground-contact footprint splatting with exponential temporal decay (lambda = 0.995) eliminates perspective scale bias and floor saturation, providing true spatial hotspot visualization without blue colormap artifacts.

features.name: GDPR & CCTV Privacy Face Anonymization
features.description: Automated facial blurring guided by 5 facial keypoints with upper-body fallback ensures complete customer privacy compliance without compromising downstream tracking or analytics.

features.name: Glassmorphism Live Web Dashboard
features.description: Multi-threaded HTTP streaming server delivering 30 FPS MJPEG video, real-time KPI counters, active dwell alerts feed, and interactive in-browser exclusion zone polygon drawing.

features.name: Hardware-Adaptive Inference Pipeline
features.description: Intelligent execution routing supporting NVIDIA CUDA GPU acceleration with automatic fallback to Intel OpenVINO IR and native PyTorch CPU.

technicalDecisions.decision: Ground-Contact Footprint Splatting over Bounding Box Fill
technicalDecisions.reasoning: Splats density exclusively at the person's floor-contact coordinates rather than painting entire bounding boxes, eliminating perspective scale distortion between foreground and background camera planes.
Decoupled track deletion from frame-level detector misses with a 3.0s grace window and clean appearance embeddings, eliminating flickering IDs and false dwell resets in crowded retail environments.

technicalDecisions.decision: Isolated Clean Frame Ingestion for ReID
technicalDecisions.reasoning: Maintains an untouched frame copy strictly for deep appearance feature extraction so that UI overlays, bounding boxes, and skeleton lines never corrupt tracker re-identification accuracy.
Avoids heavyweight web framework dependencies and event-loop threading conflicts with PyTorch/OpenCV, delivering ultra-low-latency MJPEG feeds and JSON telemetry to web clients.
